Confirmed English-only means the full advert text was read and no language other than English is required. Language unstated means the advert never said — worth a click. Filtered-out postings are kept and can be shown below, each with the reason it failed.
Work arrangement is read from the advert, not from the board's badge, and ranks fully remote above hybrid; a hybrid role shows its office days, and more than two counts against it. The three location chips group by where the job is — a Budapest role can still be fully remote.
Applied and Not for me on any row remove it — on every device, at once — and Removed lists them again if you change your mind. The first removal on a new device asks for the site password once.
